reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Preparing youth through critical-thinking education
themes.definition: AI transformation calls for education that equips young people with critical thinking and creativity, and for listening to youth.
themes.inclusion: Passages linking AI to youth, education, critical thinking or intergenerational responsibility.
themes.exclusion: Workforce reskilling without youth/education focus (use AI_ECONOMY_LABOR).
themes.boundary_cases: Youth mentioned only as future generations without education content go to other codes.

examples.quote: we should endow our young people with the means to develop their critical thinking skills and their creativity

themes.label: Extreme AI risks require responsibility
themes.definition: Reference to debates on the most extreme risks of AI as a reminder that progress cannot be divorced from responsibility.
themes.inclusion: Passages referencing extreme, catastrophic or frontier AI risks.
themes.exclusion: Everyday harms such as jobs or bias.
themes.boundary_cases: A brief nod to extreme-risk debates still counts here.

examples.quote: The current debates about the most extreme risks of AI remind us that technological progress cannot be divorced from responsibility.

themes.label: Enthusiasm alongside real concerns
themes.definition: AI transforming life and work with enthusiasm paired with very real concerns.
themes.inclusion: Passages pairing AI's possibilities with concerns.
themes.boundary_cases: Mentions of transformation of work may also take AI_ECONOMY_LABOR.

examples.quote: The enthusiasm they give rise to also goes hand in hand with the very real concerns.

themes.label: Human beings at the heart of decisions
themes.definition: Human-centred principle: people at the heart of decision-making on AI, protecting rights, security and well-being.
themes.inclusion: Passages advocating a human-centred approach and protection of rights in the face of AI.
themes.exclusion: Explicit human control over AI systems (use AI_HUMAN_CONTROL_OVERSIGHT).
themes.boundary_cases: Generic humanist principles count when stated in response to AI transformation.

examples.quote: Human beings should be at the heart of all of our decision making.

value.rationale: The Luxembourg passage frames AI through youth and education: AI brings enthusiasm and concern including extreme risks, so young people need critical-thinking education under a human-centred guiding principle.
